entries.description: Inventoried the tracked-at-HEAD Northwind footprint: 406 files under samples/GoldenOutput/NorthwindDevEdition/. Found two mirror files still TRACKED at HEAD (FormsAndReportsYaml YAML + parse-success-report JSON) contradicting the spec's 'already gitignored' premise; maintainer approved including them. .accdb/.laccdb confirmed untracked.

Converted the two hermetic golden consumers (ManifestCompletenessTests x2 theories, MigrationFixtureCoverageTests x2 theories) from [Theory] to [SkippableTheory] with Skip.IfNot(Directory.Exists(...)). Confirmed CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests (already .accdb-gated), MigrationGoldenScriptTests (HHC-only), ParseSuccessReportTests (already mirror-gated) need no change.

git rm --cached the golden tree (406) + 2 mirror files (408 total deletions), local copies preserved. Added .gitignore entries for the golden tree + parse-report mirror (YAML entry already present); expanded the comment to point at set 003.
Updated project-guidance.md Canonical Test Fixtures table (Northwind proprietary/local-only) and samples/README.md (new proprietary local-only section; corrected HomeHealthCare Primary label).

dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln => 0 errors. AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests: golden present => 794 passed/0 skipped; golden moved aside => 790 passed/4 skipped/0 failed (exactly the 4 Northwind cases). Restored golden (406 files); swept HomeHealthCare.accdb byte-drift via git restore.
Cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4): R1 ISSUES_FOUND (1 Minor doc-consistency: stale HomeHealthCare 'Secondary' label) -> fixed -> R2 VERIFIED.
Authored disposition.json (VERIFIED, next_orchestrator for Session 2), filled ai-assignment.md Session 1 actuals, persisted s1-issues.json + verification reviews, committed + pushed.

Installed git-filter-repo 2.47.0 into workspace .venv via pip; invocable as the `git filter-repo` subcommand when .venv/Scripts is on PATH (internal version a40bce548d2c). For Session 3, prefix the rewrite command with PATH=$PWD/.venv/Scripts:$PATH.

Inventoried full git history for northwind paths: 444 unique, fully bucketed (zero catch-all). Scrub set = 421 paths (406 golden + 4 samples binaries/mirrors + 5 judgment-call paths in 9 dir/file lines). Inspected all 5 judgment-call file contents; classified all SCRUB (examples/northwind-output.json = degenerate manifest of proprietary DB; tools/symbol-db 2x .md + comprehension 2x = structural disclosure). Independent cross-provider reasoning pass (gemini-pro, analysis) agreed on all 5 with no uncertainty. Keep list = 29 incidental name-matches (non-northwind set, 003 set, comparison doc, test .cs). Verified dir-prefix boundaries: comprehension/NorthwindDevEdition/ exclusive; examples/ + tools/symbol-db/ need exact paths.

Wrote scrub-allowlist.txt (9 lines, exact filter-repo input, paths only) + scrub-allowlist-rationale.md (per-path rationale, keep list, boundary checks). Sanitized the rationale doc to describe proprietary identifiers BY CATEGORY only (it is a keep-file that survives the rewrite; reproducing object names/formulas verbatim would partially defeat the remediation).

MAJOR FINDING: scanned all HEAD keep-files (excluding scrub targets) for distinctive proprietary Northwind identifiers -> 123 keep-files disclose proprietary structure, far exceeding the spec premise. Includes 2 binary SQLite DBs (symbol-db.sqlite 1.2MB + grades.sqlite 672KB) embedding full source/interpretations (CRITICAL), full proprietary procedure descriptions/translations/workflow packages (HIGH), characterization tests (MEDIUM), and name-only refs (LOW). Recorded in embedded-residue-findings.md with full 123-path inventory, severity buckets, and 3 maintainer options. NOT scrubbed (spec Out-of-Scope + Stop Rule). Requires maintainer scope decision before/at Session 3 go-ahead.

Created full backup bundle C:/temp/dabbler-access-harvester-backups/dabbler-access-harvester-pre003.bundle (--all, 16,566,494 bytes, sha256 6dd3d9bc...4a04ad recorded alongside). git bundle verify = complete history OK. Restorability proven by throwaway clone: HEAD 44122f7, 2114 files, golden tree present in cloned history. Refs captured: refs/heads/main=44122f7, origin/main=44122f7, tags v1.0.0=81fb14a, v1.1.0=0ccdd72, v1.2.0=e8ec779.

Dry-ran git filter-repo --invert-paths --paths-from-file scrub-allowlist.txt on a throwaway --mirror clone (C:/temp/nw-dryrun-mirror.git, since removed). BEFORE: 412 allowlisted objects in rev-list. AFTER: 0 allowlisted objects; git log --all empty for all 9 allowlist entries. KEEP paths all intact (HomeHealthCare golden, comprehension/scenarios.md + HHC, examples non-NW siblings, comparison doc, non-northwind set, NorthwindFixtureSmokeTests.cs). Deferred residue symbol-db.sqlite correctly STILL present (not on allowlist). Tags v1.0.0/v1.1.0/v1.2.0 resolve post-rewrite; main commit count 423 preserved; size-pack 8.83->8.24 MiB. Required env override GIT_CONFIG_*=safe.bareRepository=all because the host git sets safe.bareRepository=explicit; recorded for Session 3.

Strengthened the dry-run proof after R2 verifier caught that git rev-list --all --objects collapses content-identical blobs to one pathname (under-counted 444->346, 415->312). Redid with path-complete enumeration: union of git ls-tree -r --name-only over all reachable commits, BEFORE mirror vs filter-repo-rewritten sibling mirror. BEFORE 2626 unique paths (444 northwind), AFTER 2211 (29 northwind), removed=415=exactly allowlist-matched; expected_after==AFTER True; 0 keep lost, 0 scrub survived. Reconciles to the 415/29 bucket math.

Cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4) across 3 rounds. R1 ISSUES_FOUND (2 Major: 421-vs-415 count error, dry-run not exhaustive; 1 Minor: inventory.md keep-rationale contradiction). R2 ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major: dry-run proof anchored on rev-list --objects which blob-dedups pathnames). R3 VERIFIED, empty issues. Fixes: corrected 415 count + path-counting note; redid exhaustiveness proof path-complete via ls-tree (415 removed==matched, expected_after==AFTER); softened inventory.md keep wording + listed it LOW-bucket. Total verification cost ~$0.375 (R1 0.142 + R2 0.158 + R3 0.075).

Took fresh pre-rewrite backup bundle at HEAD 897d851 (sha256 recorded, verified). Mirror-cloned the live repo to a throwaway bare clone and ran git filter-repo 2.47.0 --invert-paths --paths-from-file scrub-allowlist.txt --force (safe.bareRepository=all env override). 426 commits reprocessed.

Verified in mirror over the path-complete historical pathname universe: BEFORE 2636 unique paths (454 northwind) -> AFTER 2221 (39 northwind); removed=415, all 415 matched by the 9-line allowlist; expected_after==after (0 keep lost, 0 scrub survived). Per-path git log --all and rev-list --objects = 0 for all 9 allowlist entries. Keep-set intact (003/004 sets, non-northwind set, comparison doc, smoke test, HHC golden, symbol-db.sqlite). Tags resolve to rewritten SHAs; main commit count preserved (426); size-pack 8.83->8.25 MiB.

Force-pushed rewritten history to private origin. main 897d851->87844e3; v1.0.0 81fb14a->842ff1b; v1.1.0 0ccdd72->991260f; v1.2.0 e8ec779->800fe15. Auth note: fresh-clone GCM helper hung (GUI dialog under non-interactive shell); pushed via -c credential.helper= (reset list) -c credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential. Independent ls-remote confirms all rewritten SHAs live on origin.

Repo is a PLAIN single-worktree checkout (not the bare+flat-worktree layout the spec assumed), so re-establishment = fetch --force --tags --prune + reset --hard origin/main + reflog expire --all + gc --prune=now in the one checkout. HEAD now 87844e3; old commit 897d851 gc-pruned and gone; 0 proprietary objects in local all-history rev-list; working tree clean; developer local untracked copies preserved (406 golden files + 12.2MB .accdb). Throwaway mirror + scratch path-lists deleted (held proprietary path names).

Wrote rewrite-record.md: allowlist used, path-complete before/after evidence, force-push old->new SHAs, plain-checkout re-establishment, retained backups, and the GitHub server-side unreachable-object caveat (private repo, no forks, Release survives tag re-point, Support can expedite GC).

Cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4, closeout-grade prose-first + trailing JSON block). R1 ISSUES_FOUND: one Major - evidence-table AFTER total transcribed 2211 instead of measured 2221 (2636-2211=425!=415); underlying rewrite correct. Fixed (AFTER=2221, embedded verbatim measured set-equality results). R2 VERIFIED, issues=[].

Closeout artifacts: rewrite-record.md, change-log.md, next-session-set-recommendation.md (routed gemini-pro, do-not-self-opine -> set 004), next-set-analysis-raw.md, disposition.json (status complete, next_session_set=004), ai-assignment.md actuals, s3 verification/issue files. About to mark_session_complete (set flips to complete) + commit/push + notify + Step 9 reorg review.
